name: remote
title: Remote manager
summary: Urgent alerts on your phone through a Telegram bot you create yourself, and decisions from the phone. Only people you pair here can use it, and only those who also set a PIN and an authenticator app here can decide: approve or deny actions, answer the agent's questions, give verdicts and let held devices in.
needs: An outgoing connection to api.telegram.org; nothing is opened to the internet
An authenticator app on the phone (Aegis, Google Authenticator or the like) to decide from it
